title: Atelier Stage Chart — Work Shares for Made-to-Order Pairs by Production Stage (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
The work share kept when a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation is cancelled during production follows the production stage the pair has reached. The stage is measured in calendar days, with the day the count starts from not counted and the end day counted.

| Workshop stage | Production stage reached | Work share |
|---|---|---|
| Cutting | Fewer than 14 days | 15 percent |
| Lasting and stitching | 14 days up to fewer than 28 days | 30 percent |
| Finishing | 28 days or more | 50 percent, the standard work share |

The work share is a share of the reserved price of the pair, the reserved unit price times the units.

**Both sides of each threshold**

| Production stage | Stage | Work share |
|---|---|---|
| 13 days | Cutting | 15 percent |
| 14 days | Lasting and stitching | 30 percent |
| 27 days | Lasting and stitching | 30 percent |
| 28 days | Finishing | 50 percent |

**Stage questions**

*Does a pair reach lasting and stitching on day 14 or day 15?* On day 14. Fourteen days is the first day of lasting and stitching.

*Is a pair at 28 days still in lasting and stitching?* No. At 28 days or more the pair is in finishing, and the work share is 50 percent.
